caption: The drawing depicts a long, continuous band featuring a composition of stylized botanical elements. Along the horizontal strip, various flowers, leaves, and stems are arranged in an intertwined pattern. The color palette comprises greens, pinks, reds, blues, and yellows, with each flower or leaf rendered in a single color or a blend of hues. On the left, a large green and blue zigzag motif is bordered by pink and red flowers and leaves, with small berry-like shapes scattered nearby. Moving right, a large yellow and green leaf shape sits next to smaller pink blossoms and blue flowers with round petals. Farther to the right, a mixture of pink, red, and yellow flowers, along with green and blue leaves, are connected by slender curving green stems. The botanical forms vary in size and complexity, with some leaves showing veins and some flowers having radiating petals or dotted centers. The background is a pale beige, and the drawing is segmented into three joined panels, each seamlessly continuing the motif.
title: Valance
